checks.name: Open side-thumb contact cavity has no support bead negative
Side-thumb curved wall printed across layers negative
Side-thumb floor and lower round emitted negative
No outer-wall restart in deepest thumb-seat center negative
checks.method: Observed extrusion starts after travel/retraction or feature change; seam candidates, not explicit slicer seam markers. Central means X within 3 mm of the cutter center and within 1.2 mm of deepest radial contact, above the floor round and below the crown.

checks.method: Observed extrusion starts after travel/retraction or feature change; seam candidates, not explicit slicer seam markers. Central means X within 3 mm of the cutter center and within 1.2 mm of deepest radial contact, above the floor round and below the crown.

scope: Whole support bead XY sweep and layer height tested against each open cutter disk plus the explicitly declared round allowance above its hand-facing floor. Floor underside supports below the contact plane are outside this check. Curved outer wall layers and floor/round model paths must exist.
limitations: Nominal sliced paths only; actual hand fit, surface texture and support removal remain physical checks.
